bullets.text: ASA Bans Vodafone Ads - The ASA finds Vodafone's 'Nation's Network' slogan misleading, banning the campaign for lack of evidence.
BT Sells US Federal Unit - BT divests its US government contracting operation to focus on a multi-cloud strategy.
Cyberattack Costs Surge - Average recovery costs from cyberattacks hit $2.5 million, highlighting the need for resilience.
AI in Service Provider Networks - AI and ML are becoming essential for modern service provider networks to meet subscriber demands.
UK Cyber Defences Boosted - The UK government allocates £210 million to enhance cybersecurity across public services.
Fastweb and TIM 5G Partnership - Fastweb and TIM agree on a RAN sharing model to accelerate 5G deployment in Italy.
Wi-Fi Alliance Expands Wi-Fi 7 - New certification brings Wi-Fi 7 features to 20 MHz-only devices, enhancing IoT capabilities.
SoftBank's Strategic Acquisition - SoftBank's acquisition of DigitalBridge reflects a shift towards AI-driven telecom infrastructure.
